tagline: Leading provider of specialized services focused on the design, installation, upgrade and repair of infrastructure assets for energy, communications, utility and other end markets
hero_kpi_rationale: The backlog of $43.98B (+27.3% YoY) reflects strong demand for electrical infrastructure solutions related to data centers, electrification and grid modernization, which are the primary growth drivers for the company.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Total amount of spending on property, plant and equipment as well as intangible assets, and investments in strategic acquisitions.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures reflect the resources allocated to the acquisition or modernization of the company's assets, as well as strategic acquisitions that expand capabilities.
kpis.signal: Significant investments to support growth and strategic acquisitions, notably Cupertino Electric and Dynamic Systems.

kpis.name: Backlog
kpis.explanation: Total value of signed contracts not yet executed.
kpis.description: Backlog represents expected future revenues from already signed contracts, reflecting sustained demand from data centers, grid modernization and electrification.
kpis.signal: Significant backlog growth, indicating strong future demand for electrical infrastructure and renewable solutions.

kpis.name: Remaining Performance Obligations
kpis.explanation: Expected future revenues from signed contracts under GAAP standards, representing work not yet performed.
kpis.description: This KPI represents guaranteed future revenues from ongoing contracts, GAAP measure of future backlog.
kpis.signal: Strong increase in remaining performance obligations, indicating sustained business activity and growing demand.

kpis.name: Acquisition Cupertino Electric, Inc. (CEI)
kpis.explanation: Impact of CEI acquisition in 2024 on expanding electrical design and installation solutions for data centers and renewable energy.
kpis.description: The 2024 acquisition of CEI expanded Quanta Services' offering in electrical design and installation solutions for data centers and solar/energy storage projects.
kpis.signal: The CEI acquisition strengthened capabilities in critical electrical solutions for technology and renewable energy industries.

kpis.name: Acquisition Dynamic Systems (DSI), LLC
kpis.explanation: Expansion of mechanical infrastructure and process solutions capabilities through the 2025 acquisition of DSI.
kpis.description: The 2025 acquisition of DSI enabled Quanta Services to expand its capabilities in turnkey solutions for mechanical infrastructure, plumbing and process systems, targeting data centers and other industrial facilities.
kpis.signal: The DSI acquisition broadened service offerings for data centers, manufacturing and semiconductors.

risks.title: Revenue Seasonality
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in the first section of the 10-K, with explicit language about recurring impact on revenues and costs. The company emphasizes that seasonal fluctuations affect each quarter in a predictable manner, particularly in the United States. The Industrial category is weighted moderately, but the regularity and magnitude of the phenomenon justify high severity.

risks.title: Impact of Weather Conditions and Natural Disasters
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly cites risks related to extreme weather events (hurricanes, floods, pandemics, etc.) that may cause delays, increased costs or project cancellations. The language is strong: exposure to significant liabilities, and the link to climate change reinforces severity. Geopolitical category including climate risks is weighted at maximum.

risks.title: Customer Demand Fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: The risk is described as dependent on major external factors (economic conditions, regulations, interest rates, tax credits). The text emphasizes the absence of firm contractual commitments for work volumes. The language is repeated and detailed, indicating structural exposure. The Competitive category is moderately weighted, but the scope of factors justifies high severity.

risks.title: Margin Risk Related to Project Mix
risks.score_rationale: The document explains that small projects or those with significant subcontracting reduce margins, while large projects, though more profitable, are subject to regulatory delays. The language shows strategic concern: transition inefficiency, workforce underutilization. Capital category weighted for profitability impact, high severity.

risks.title: Fixed-Price Contract Execution
risks.score_rationale: The company specifies that a significant portion of revenues comes from fixed-price contracts, especially on large projects, where it assumes estimation and execution risks. The text explicitly mentions the risk of losses, change orders or disputes. Strong language: profit reduction, project losses. Credit category includes contractual default risk, maximum severity.

risks.title: Reliance on Subcontracting and Materials
risks.score_rationale: Subcontracting (20% of work) and material supply reduce margins, as material margin is low. The text also mentions price volatility risk. Central position in the 10-K, precise language on profitability impact. Industrial category moderately weighted, but major operational risk.

ai_positioning.summary: Company PWR does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
